import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/training_5.csv"
]

# Columns and their target dtypes as per target schema
target_columns = [
    'Timestamp [ms]',
    'CPU cores',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [%]',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]',
    'Memory usage [KB]',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]',
    'Timestamp'
]

# Load all source dataframes
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source dataframes vertically
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Add the 'Timestamp' string column by converting 'Timestamp [ms]' to datetime string
union_df['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(union_df['Timestamp [ms]'], unit='s').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# Enforce target schema dtypes explicitly
union_df = union_df.astype({
    'Timestamp [ms]': 'int64',
    'CPU cores': 'int64',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]': 'float64',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]': 'float64',
    'CPU usage [%]': 'float64',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]': 'int64',
    'Memory usage [KB]': 'float64',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]': 'int64',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]': 'float64',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]': 'float64',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]': 'float64',
    'Timestamp': 'string'
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
union_df = union_df[target_columns]

# Write the result to the target CSV file
union_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_22/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
